# stalwart_mta_route_mx (Data Source)

Defines a routing rule for outbound message delivery. Reads the Remote Delivery (MX) variant.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object. Set either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Short identifier for the route

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A short description of the route, which can be used to identify it in the list of routes
- `ip_lookup_strategy` (String) IP resolution strategy for MX hosts
- `max_multihomed` (Number) For multi-homed remote servers, it is the maximum number of IP addresses to try on each delivery attempt
- `max_mx_hosts` (Number) Maximum number of MX hosts to try on each delivery attempt
